Yes, they're worth it—especially as a web dev. These free Anthropic courses (Claude 101, AI Fluency, Claude Code in Action, API building) are short (1-2 hours each), self-paced with videos/quizzes, and give official certificates of completion.

Claude Code and API ones are practical for devs: learn CLI tools, workflows, context management. Great foundation for AI integration. Add the certs to LinkedIn/resume—they're from a top lab and signal real skills. Enroll and knock out a couple today.
